description: In weakly coupled nonequilibrium linear stochastic systems, the Markov blanket condition and the restrictions on solenoidal flow hold only in a very narrow region of parameters, and the averaging step behind the variational reading does not hold in general.
limitations: Linear systems only. The authors call for further development rather than rejecting the theory.

sources.quote: This equivalence does not hold in general even for linear systems, since it requires an effective decoupling from the system's history of interactions.
we examine in depth the assumptions required to derive the FEP in the simplest possible set of systems – weakly-coupled non-equilibrium linear stochastic systems
